name: Dodge Viper TA 2.0 '15
description:
The Viper TA 2.0 is the revised version of the TA for 2015. Most noticeable changes are in the new aero kit, with new elements and rear wing, which generates 180 kg of downforce at 240 km/h (400lbs@150mph), about 45% hihger than the regular TA. Thanks to this, the car is faster than the previous version on the track, but its top speed decrease arround 10 km/h.

Laguna Seca lap time: ~1:31-1:32 (ideal conditions).
author: BZ SimWorks (Beto FR)
